name: immunology
description: Datenpaket für Immunologen: Autoimmun-Labor (ANA, Sjögren, Komplement, Immunglobuline), MCAS-Marker, autonome Dysregulation, Symptomzeitachse
description_en: Data package for immunologists: autoimmune labs (ANA, Sjögren, complement, immunoglobulins), MCAS markers, autonomic dysregulation, symptom timeline

queries.autoimmune_labs: SELECT date, parameter, wert AS value, einheit AS unit, ref_min AS range_min, ref_max AS range_max, status, labor AS lab FROM lab_all WHERE person = :person AND parameter IN ('ANA','dsDNA-AK','Anti-Sm','Anti-SSA','Anti-SSB','Anti-Ro52','Anti-Ro60','Anti-La','Rheumafaktor','cyklisches citrulliniertes Peptid (CCP)','AMA','ASMA','Anti-Jo1','Antiphospholipid-AK','Lupus-Antikoagulans','Cardiolipin-IgG','Cardiolipin-IgM','Beta2-Glykoprotein-IgG','Beta2-Glykoprotein-IgM','C3-Komplement','C4-Komplement','CH50','IgG','IgA','IgM','IgE gesamt','IgG-Subklassen','ANA-Titer','Anti-dsDNA','RF','Anti-CCP','C3','C4','IgE') AND date BETWEEN :date_from AND :date_to ORDER BY date, parameter
queries.mcas_allergy_labs: SELECT date, parameter, wert AS value, einheit AS unit, ref_min AS range_min, ref_max AS range_max, status, labor AS lab FROM lab_all WHERE person = :person AND parameter IN ('Tryptase','Histamin','Chromogranin-A','Heparin','VMA','5-HIAA','Prostaglandin-D2','LTE4','RANTES','IL-4','IL-5','IL-13','IgE gesamt','RAST','Gesamt-IgE') AND date BETWEEN :date_from AND :date_to ORDER BY date, parameter
queries.inflammation_markers: SELECT date, parameter, wert AS value, einheit AS unit, ref_min AS range_min, ref_max AS range_max, status, labor AS lab FROM lab_all WHERE person = :person AND parameter IN ('CRP','CRP-hs','Blutsenkung 1. Std','BSG 1h','Ferritin','Interleukin 6','TNF-alpha','Leukozyten','Lymphozyten','NK-Zellen','CD4','CD8','CD4/CD8-Ratio','Thrombozyten','D-Dimer','vWF Antigen','vWF RCo Aktivität','vWF RCo:vWF Ag Ratio','LDH','BSG','BSG_1h','IL-6','vWF') AND date BETWEEN :date_from AND :date_to ORDER BY date, parameter
queries.immune_autonomic_symptoms: SELECT date, symptom, value_num, value_text, category FROM symptoms WHERE person = :person AND (symptom LIKE '%Urtikaria%' OR symptom LIKE '%urticaria%' OR symptom LIKE '%Flush%' OR symptom LIKE '%flush%' OR symptom LIKE '%Anaphylaxie%' OR symptom LIKE '%anaphylaxis%' OR symptom LIKE '%Juckreiz%' OR symptom LIKE '%pruritus%' OR symptom LIKE '%Schwellung%' OR symptom LIKE '%edema%' OR symptom LIKE '%Bauchschmerz%' OR symptom LIKE '%abdominal%' OR symptom LIKE '%Rhinitis%' OR symptom LIKE '%rhinitis%' OR symptom LIKE '%Histamin%' OR symptom LIKE '%Erschöpfung%' OR symptom LIKE '%Fatigue%' OR symptom LIKE '%brain_fog%' OR symptom LIKE '%Kognition%' OR symptom LIKE '%Mundtrockenheit%' OR symptom LIKE '%xerostomia%' OR symptom LIKE '%Augentrockenheit%' OR symptom LIKE '%xerophthalmia%' OR symptom LIKE '%Raynaud%') AND date BETWEEN :date_from AND :date_to ORDER BY date
queries.orthostatic_tests: SELECT date, hr_supine, hr_stand_peak, hr_stand, hr_delta, rmssd_supine, rmssd_stand, rmssd_delta, source_app FROM orthostatic_test WHERE person = :person AND date BETWEEN :date_from AND :date_to ORDER BY date
queries.daily_hrv_autonomic: SELECT date, person, hrv_rmssd_ms, resting_hr_bpm AS hr_resting, spo2_avg_pct AS spo2_avg, NULL AS spo2_min, resp_rate_avg AS respiration_avg, ROUND(stress_high_s/60.0,1) AS stress_high_min, steps FROM daily_context WHERE person = :person AND date BETWEEN :date_from AND :date_to ORDER BY date
queries.arrhythmia_episodes: SELECT episode_start, episode_end, dauer_min, n_fenster, hr_mean, time_of_day, detection_method FROM arrhythmie_episoden WHERE person = :person AND date(episode_start) BETWEEN :date_from AND :date_to ORDER BY episode_start
queries.clinical_findings: SELECT finding_date, period_end, category, finding_type, value, unit, threshold, status, severity, description FROM clinical_findings WHERE finding_date BETWEEN :date_from AND :date_to ORDER BY severity, finding_date
queries.medications: SELECT ts, date, drug_name, dose_value, dose_unit, route, notes FROM medications WHERE person = :person AND date BETWEEN :date_from AND :date_to ORDER BY ts
queries.blood_count: SELECT date, parameter, wert AS value, einheit AS unit, ref_min AS range_min, ref_max AS range_max, kommentar AS ref_text, status, wert AS value_text, labor AS lab FROM lab_all WHERE person = :person AND parameter IN ('Leukozyten','Erythrozyten','Hämoglobin','Hämatokrit','MCV','MCH','MCHC','RDW','Thrombozyten') AND date BETWEEN :date_from AND :date_to ORDER BY date, parameter
queries.infection_serology: SELECT date, parameter, wert AS value_text, status, labor AS lab FROM lab_all WHERE person = :person AND parameter IN ('HBs_Ag','Anti_HBs','Anti_HBc','Anti_HCV','Anti_HAV_IgM','HIV_Kombitest','Lues','C_trachomatis_IgG','C_trachomatis_IgA') AND date BETWEEN :date_from AND :date_to ORDER BY date, parameter
queries.lab_parameters_available: SELECT parameter, COUNT(*) AS n, MIN(date) AS first_date, MAX(date) AS last_date FROM lab_all WHERE person = :person GROUP BY parameter ORDER BY parameter

algorithm_note: Arrhythmie-Episoden werden mit einem heuristischen CV-Schwellenwert detektiert (nicht klinisch validiert). Für MCAS-Abklärung sind punktuelle Tryptase-Messungen aus lab_all relevanter als Wearable-Daten.
